label: RAF capture room: a large room with soft walls and a smaller concrete-walled room (Meta Reality Labs)
note: Paper section 3: one room of two parts, a large one with soft-material walls and a smaller one with concrete walls for more reverberation; conditions empty (only the equipment) and furnished (as a simple studio or living room). Figure 2 (dimensions drawn on the empty room): L-shaped plan 8.8 m long, 6.1 m deep along the first 4.9 m and 3.7 m deep along the other 3.9 m; the large part 6.8 m long and 2.6 m high, the smaller part 3.9 m high. Volume not stated: about 125 m3 from these dimensions, and Table 1's 372 samples/m3 with the empty room's 47,484 IRs gives 128 m3. Motion-capture cameras on the walls (Figure 1); Decay times depend on position: about 0.35-0.7 s (empty) and 0.25-0.55 s (furnished) in most of the room, 0.95 s and 0.67 s at receivers 2 m or more to the left (Z), which fits the smaller concrete-walled part; EDT (0.25 s) is half of T30, as in coupled rooms
